text:
elena-cs: heads up — Novelytics reporting a big regression on embeddings p99 (~18s) since ~04:30 UTC yesterday after a deploy. Customers hitting timeouts. Can SRE confirm? @aditya-sre

aditya-sre: looking now. I can see tenant=novelytics has queue depth spike on embed-route-us-east and embed-worker-3 showing high task latency. redis latency also elevated (slow commands). not sure if it's noisy neighbor or a codepath change.

samir-eng: quick check — there was a model-side rollout yesterday: deploy-bot shows `embed-lg-v2` rolled at 04:25 UTC to us-east. could be the new kernel path. samir-eng: Paging @novelytics-eng for any traffic pattern changes.

novelytics-eng: yes we pushed a burst of bulk indexing late last night but within usual QPS. nothing we changed at 04:30. seeing many 504s and retries on our side.

maria-support: customer is anxious, asking for ETA. asked if we can provide temporary mitigation (rate limit / reserveration / fallback).

aditya-sre: digging traces — span shows most time in `enqueue_wait` before worker pickup. service p50 fine, p95 ~600ms, p99 ~18s. worker CPU not pegged but one host (embed-worker-3) has queue depth 6x others. likely a hot shard.

ops-bot: infra alert: redis-node-7 latency > 200ms (connected to embed-route-us-east) at 04:28UTC — elevated until 05:10UTC.

samir-eng: OK quick mitigations I'd push: 1) temporarily move tenant to a different shard or priority lane; 2) spin an ephemeral reservation for Novelytics for next 2 hours; 3) route them to embed-sm-quant (lower latency) as fallback. I can run 1+2 now.

aditya-sre: agree. also recommend warming KV cache for the smaller model. I’ll check hotspotting keys (tenant-specific prefixes) and purge stuck tasks.

samir-eng: performed: created reservation res-7754, applied to tenant=novelytics (1h). moved routing policy -> priority_lane_temp for reqs from novelytics to embed-sm-quant in us-east.

elena-cs: told Novelytics we’re applying a temporary route + reservation; asked them to validate.

novelytics-eng: testing now — embedding requests dropped p99 from 18s -> 1.2s for a subset routed to the smaller model. The bulk indexing still has a few tails on older shard though. :slightly_smiling_face:

aditya-sre: logs after reroute: embed-worker-3 queue drain in progress. redis-node-7 latency back to normal. Will continue to monitor. Action items: 1) roll back embed-lg-v2 to previous build on embed-worker-3 only and redeploy with kernel debug flags; 2) investigate shard balancing; 3) postmortem if we find a regression.

maria-support: customer asked for a short RCA and timeline. we offered to keep reservation until 10:00 UTC and follow up with more detailed timeline by EOD.

samir-eng: created incident ticket INC-2026-998 in internal tracker and added links to logs + pcap. assigned to aditya-sre for root cause.

aditya-sre: repro steps I used (for SRE / Eng):
```bash
# single request repro (from loadtest box)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lg-v2","input":"lorem ipsum"}' | jq .
```
Then run 50 concurrent to reproduce queue backing. Watch `kubectl top pods` and `redis-cli --latency-history`.

aditya-sre: initial hypothesis: kernel selection change for embed-lg-v2 increases per-request scheduling jitter leading to hotspot on worker-3 when combined with our routing hash. mitigation options: adjust routing hash to spread tenant shards, or pin tenant to a less bursty worker pool.

elena-cs: customer is satisfied with temporary fix for now and asked for an ETA on a permanent fix. I told them we’ll follow up after RCA.

maria-support: logging followup: will share timeline + our mitigation steps with customer and offer usage credit for the impacted window.

aditya-sre: monitoring: adding short-term alert to fire if novelytics p99 > 2s for next 6 hours and will schedule rollback test on embed-lg-v2 in staging.

samir-eng: next steps: (1) repro and isolate kernel regression (aditya), (2) shard rebalance (infra), (3) long-term: improve routing hash to avoid single-worker hotspots.

elena-cs: thanks all. closing this thread after we confirm RCA. :white_check_mark:
